title: Xuanzhi Trace Event
description: Structured trace event for auditability, recovery, reporting, and governance accountability in the Xuanzhi workspace.

schema_version.description: Version of this trace event schema.

trace_id.description: Canonical identifier of this trace event.

reasoning_summary.description: Optional concise explanation of why the path or decision existed. Must remain summary-level and must not contain raw chain-of-thought.

status_summary.description: Optional concise statement of the resulting condition or outcome.

task_id.description: Optional canonical task identifier linked to this event.

step_id.description: Optional canonical step identifier linked to this event.

parent_trace_id.description: Optional parent trace identifier when this event belongs to a larger trace chain.

parent_task_id.description: Optional parent task identifier when relevant.

epic_id.description: Optional epic identifier for long-running work.

milestone_id.description: Optional milestone identifier for long-running work.

initiator.description: Optional actor that initiated the request, action, or path.

executor.description: Optional actor or system that performed the action.

approver.description: Optional actor or authority that granted or denied approval.

task_state.description: Optional task-level runtime state associated with this event.

step_state.description: Optional step-level runtime state associated with this event.

review_state.description: Optional review state associated with this event.

approval_state.description: Optional approval state associated with this event.

lifecycle_state.description: Optional durable administrative state when trace concerns a registry or lifecycle transition.

risk_level.description: Optional categorical risk level associated with this event.

risk_score.description: Optional granular risk score when a numeric score is available and meaningful.

artifact_refs.description: Optional references to changed or produced artifacts. Prefer references over embedded bulk payloads.

failure_summary.description: Optional concise summary of what failed.

resolution_action.description: Optional concise description of the next recovery or control action, such as replan, escalate, retry, or stop.

severity.description: Optional severity label, especially useful for alerts or abnormal events.

memory_level.description: Optional memory layer affected by a memory trace event.

checkpoint_id.description: Optional checkpoint identifier for long-running work.

snapshot_type.description: Optional snapshot type when a compact reconstruction-friendly capture is relevant.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the trace event was created.

notes.description: Optional bounded operational note. Should remain concise.
